templates.pat: This mode accepts the {{1}} to retrieve the corresponding entry. The identifier may be in the form of a database-dependent prefix followed by a five-digit number, such as C00002 for ATP, or in the form of db:entry, such as hsa:7157 or hsa:TP53 for human p53. When the search term does not match any of the KEGG identifiers, a keyword search is performed by DBGET. This is equivalent to the DBGET search below.
templates.zh: 此模式接受 {{1}}，以检索对应条目。标识符可以是「数据库相关前缀 + 五位数字」的形式，例如 ATP 的 C00002；也可以是 db:entry 的形式，例如人类 p53 的 hsa:7157 或 hsa:TP53。当检索词不匹配任何 KEGG 标识符时，由 DBGET 执行关键词检索。这等同于下方的 DBGET 检索。

templates.pat: This mode performs the DBGET search against the entire KEGG database. See more details in {{1}}.
templates.zh: 此模式对整个 KEGG 数据库执行 DBGET 检索。更多细节见 {{1}}。

templates.pat: This mode is the default in the KEGG MEDICUS page. A keyword search is performed against KEGG PATHWAY, KEGG DISEASE, and KEGG DRUG relational databases (see RDB search in {{1}}), as well as FDA Drug labels for both prescription and OTC drugs in the DailyMed database.
templates.zh: 此模式是 KEGG MEDICUS 页面中的默认模式。它会对 KEGG PATHWAY、KEGG DISEASE 和 KEGG DRUG 关系数据库（参见 {{1}} 中的 RDB search），以及 DailyMed 数据库中处方药与非处方药的 FDA 药品说明书执行关键词检索。
